title: Settings
description: Account, DeepSeek AI, Cloudflare usage, GitHub PAT, and preferences

toasts.cloudflareTestSuccess: Account readable (probes Analytics access only, not full dataset permissions)
toasts.trackingSaved: Tracking thresholds updated and health recalculated
toasts.publicBrowsingSaveFailed: Failed to save public browsing setting

password.title: Change password
password.newMin: New password must be at least 8 characters

deepseek.description: Used for one-line summaries, folder suggestions, and smart tags. Keys are stored with AES-GCM encryption.
deepseek.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved key (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep

anysearch.description: Optional. Enables the "Web" toggle in library chat so answers can be supplemented with web results. Keys are stored with AES-GCM encryption and used server-side only.
anysearch.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved key (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep
anysearch.keyRequired: Please enter an AnySearch API Key
anysearch.hint: Create a key in the console:
anysearch.clearConfirm: Clear the AnySearch API Key? Library chat will lose web search.

cloudflare.description: Powers Free-tier Workers / D1 remaining quota on the Insights page. Create an API Token with Account Analytics read access. The token is stored with AES-GCM encryption and never returned in plain text.
cloudflare.savedTokenPlaceholder: Saved token (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep
cloudflare.hint: Limits are account-wide and reset at 00:00 UTC. After configuring, open Insights to view remaining quota.
cloudflare.clearConfirm: Clear the Cloudflare Account ID and API Token?
cloudflare.needBoth: Provide an Account ID, or a Token when an Account ID is already saved
cloudflare.testHint: Only confirms the Token can read this Account; it does not prove access to every Analytics dataset

github.description: Optional. A PAT raises GitHub REST API rate limits for stars and sync.
github.savedPatPlaceholder: Saved PAT (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep
github.clearConfirm: Clear the GitHub PAT? Stars import and sync will fall back to unauthenticated rate limits.

import.description: Batch-import your starred GitHub repos as bookmarks. Import runs in the background one-by-one (including AI), and continues if you leave this page. Requires a GitHub PAT configured above.
import.patRequired: Please configure a GitHub PAT above before importing.

tracking.description: The system syncs GitHub activity and pending jobs about every 10 minutes. Adjust hot / stale day thresholds; saving recalculates locally from existing push times without extra GitHub calls. Per-bookmark tracking can be disabled in detail view.
tracking.eventsDescription: Choose which repository changes the sync job records into your feed. Turning one off stops new events of that type; existing ones stay.

bookmarkList.description: Instance-level setting: how the bookmarks page loads more items. Signed-in users and public visitors share the same configuration.
bookmarkList.modeHint: Both append modes enable virtual scrolling, so long lists only render cards near the viewport.
bookmarkList.pageSizeInvalid: Items per page must be an integer between 1 and 100

visibility.description: Control whether signed-out visitors can read-only browse bookmarks and feed.
visibility.publicBrowsingDescription: When enabled, anyone with the link can read bookmarks and feed; when disabled, sign-in is required. Adding bookmarks and creating folders still require sign-in. Private notes stay hidden from guests.

analytics.description: Enter a Google Analytics Measurement ID to inject tracking site-wide.
analytics.hint: Copy the G- Measurement ID from Google Analytics — do not paste the full script snippet.
analytics.invalidMeasurementId: Invalid Measurement ID. Expected format: G-XXXXXXXXXX
analytics.clearConfirm: Clear the Google Analytics measurement ID?

export.description: Export all bookmarks, folders, and tags as JSON. Site accounts and passwords are excluded.
export.title: Export full library JSON
export.detail: Includes private notes, AI summaries, tags, and timestamps — not site accounts or passwords
export.mdDetail: Bookmarks grouped by folder with title, link, AI summary, tags, and notes — for reading or archiving elsewhere

danger.foldersNote: Removes all bookmarks, folders, tags, feed history, and chat archives. Your account and settings are kept, and preset folders return automatically after you sign back in.
danger.confirmDescription: This deletes every bookmark, folder, tag, feed event, and chat archive. Your account and settings stay, and preset folders return after re-login. This cannot be undone.
